_notes: API: Hydrochlorothiazide (HCT). Visible label: 'A6 R6 P9/2 HCT'.
100% standard: 2 mg/mL × 2 µL spotting volume = 4.000 µg/spot.
Corner arrangement ROTATES the landscape image to portrait (origin=bottom, front=top).
Rf ≈ 0.33 (spots appear at ~30% from left edge in original landscape image).
Source: Hauk et al., Sci. Rep. 12, 13433 (2022), Supplementary Figure S4.
_cornerNote: Corners ROTATED for portrait output. Plate boundary estimated from image.
_spotNote2: xFractions from spot y-positions in original: (y_orig - plate_top) / plate_height.
